risk_and_sentiment: Sentiment is constructive but selective: 260 positive, 201 negative, and 1341 neutral articles. My read is to avoid treating headline volume as conviction by itself; the more important signal is whether macro-sensitive and technology-sensitive stories are pointing in the same direction.
